teaser.en: The 'male' jirimata: a grass whose spiny burrs are sharp enough to earn a place among the thorny plants.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'dume': nyasi ambayo miiba ya vishada vyake ni mikali kiasi cha kuiweka miongoni mwa mimea ya miiba.

summary.en: Jirimata lume is a burr-grass whose seed-heads break up into small, sharply spined burrs. Digo people count it as the 'male' jirimata because its spines are sharper and fiercer than those of the 'female', Pupalia lappacea.
summary.sw: Jirimata lume ni nyasi ambayo vichwa vyake vya mbegu hugawanyika kuwa vishada vidogo vyenye miiba mikali. Wadigo huihesabu kuwa jirimata 'dume' kwa sababu miiba yake ni mikali na hatari zaidi kuliko ya 'jike', Pupalia lappacea.

about.en: Jirimata lume is a grass with slender stems and narrow leaves. Its flower-heads are dense spikes of small burrs. Each burr is a cluster of spikelets enclosed in a ring of bristles and spines, and when ripe it falls away whole. The spines catch in skin, cloth and fur. Digo people identify the plant by these fruits.
about.sw: Jirimata lume ni nyasi yenye mashina membamba na majani membamba. Vichwa vyake vya maua ni masuke mazito ya vishada vidogo vya miiba. Kila kishada ni kikundi cha vishuke kilichozungukwa na duara la vinywele vigumu na miiba, na kikikomaa hudondoka kizima. Miiba hunasa kwenye ngozi, nguo na manyoya ya wanyama. Wadigo huitambua nyasi hii kwa matunda haya.

where.en: It grows in open, sandy or disturbed ground, in grassland and bush, on paths and around homesteads.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye ardhi wazi, yenye mchanga au iliyovurugwa, katika nyika za nyasi na vichakani, njiani na kuzunguka makazi.

culture.en: Digo people use male and female labels to pair similar plants. Pakia found that sharp, dangerous features are thought of as male and gentle, harmless ones as female. The spikes of *Cenchrus mitis* are sharper than those of *Pupalia lappacea*, so this grass is *jirimata lume*, 'male jirimata', and *Pupalia* is the female. Pakia also lists *jirimata* with *chikombe tsui* and *mnyondoya* under *miya*, 'thorns', a cover term for all prickly plants.
culture.sw: Wadigo hutumia lebo za dume na jike kuoanisha mimea inayofanana. Pakia aligundua kwamba sifa kali na hatari huchukuliwa kuwa za kiume, na zile za upole zisizo na madhara kuwa za kike. Miiba ya *Cenchrus mitis* ni mikali kuliko ya *Pupalia lappacea*, kwa hivyo nyasi hii ni *jirimata lume*, 'jirimata dume', na *Pupalia* ndiye jike. Pakia pia anaorodhesha *jirimata* pamoja na *chikombe tsui* na *mnyondoya* chini ya *miya*, 'miiba', jina la jumla la mimea yote yenye miiba.

names.en: Digo: *jirimata lume*, 'male jirimata'. Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name. Plants of this genus are known elsewhere as burr-grasses or sandburs.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata lume*, 'jirimata dume'. Pakia anairekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Kwingineko, mimea ya jenasi hii hujulikana kama *burr-grasses* au *sandburs*.

reason.en: Jirimata futswe, which takes jirimata's form without the burrs
reason.sw: Jirimata futswe, unaochukua umbo la jirimata bila miiba

reason.en: Grouped with it under miya, the thorny plants
reason.sw: Umewekwa pamoja nayo chini ya miya, mimea ya miiba

reason.en: Governor's plum, another plant in the miya group
reason.sw: Mchongoma (governor's plum), mmea mwingine wa kundi la miya

reason.en: Guinea grass, another common grass of the bush
reason.sw: Nyasi ya Guinea (Guinea grass), nyasi nyingine ya kawaida ya vichakani
